1. Validator name: henrystage

2. Networks and AuM: Founder and operator of Worrell Chain (Cosmos SDK): I launched and ran testnet 1, and testnet 2 started 10 Nov 2026 with 47 active validators that I coordinate. Self-funded, self-operated, not a staking service. Worrell Chain's validator set includes ITRocket, NodeStake, Grand Valley, Fluxen, HusoNode, MictoNode, UTSA, VALIDARIOS, ZeycaNode, BoyGau, BonyNode and Vinjan.Inc, among others.

3. Links: GitHub https://github.com/henrystage | X https://x.com/worrellchain | Discord handle: henrystage

4. Contact: Discord henrystage

5. Why gno.land: I got involved in blockchain because I wanted to understand how a network governs itself and how decentralization can create value for everyone. I'm particularly interested in the operational side of blockchain networks: running infrastructure, participating actively, and helping wherever I can. My experience developing a blockchain project has strengthened that interest, and becoming a validator on your network would be another opportunity to keep learning and growing. I also see the possibility of earning a sustainable income from this activity in the future. But beyond that, I value the opportunity to be part of something meaningful and contribute to its success.

6. Contributions to gno.land: Full node on Onyx since November 2026, synced from genesis through all coordinated upgrades. Willing to contribute to tooling, documentation, the project roadmap, and anywhere else I can help and be useful.

Setup: Contabo cloud (EU), Ubuntu 24.04, 8 vCPU, 24 GB RAM, 600 GB SSD. RPC bound to localhost, p2p only exposed port. Open to deploying a more complete setup (sentry nodes, remote signer) if required.
